title: Ukrainian Chicken Noodles
description: A kid-friendly Ukrainian dish featuring lemongrass and shio-cure, this recipe is both grassy and fluffy, making it a perfect meal for the whole family. It is also buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any animal by-products or strong flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bruised lemongrass and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the grated carrots and cook until they are tender.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Stir in the shio-cure and cook for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over the cooked noodles.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
